issues.issue: All business-type receipts (122,991.25) are in other. That follows the user's label decision ('local receipts other' -> other) and the 2026-11-06 utility 'other revenue' ruling, because the page doesn't count them as charges for services. But Guide_Rock_FY2024 records the same Sewer/Water row as Utility Charges, so the two years are inconsistent. Applies to receipts[12] and detail Sewer/Water revenue lines too. Left as is; flagged for awareness only.
